description: Where liquidations WOULD happen for one coin: the liquidation heatmap over time built from real tracked Hyperliquid positions. Returns the largest clusters of liquidatable positions above the mark (shorts) and below it (longs) in the newest snapshot, with USD at risk and the distance from the mark. Use it for "where are the liquidation levels / magnets for BTC?". For liquidations that already happened use get_liquidations.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

end.description: End of the window (default now). Set it to look at the heatmap of an earlier time.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24; capped by the plan history).

tf.description: Column interval (default: chosen from hours: 15m up to 7 days, 1h up to 30 days, then 4h / 12h). Intervals outside the plan answer plan_required.

name: get_liquidation_heatmap
title: Liquidation heatmap
